main_text.p: scriptis Patrum vel leviter versatus, qui non ingenuè profiteatur, sanctos Domini Apostolos Canones istos minimè condidisse; Quare omnis inter litteratos de hoc argumento controversia, ad majorem vel minorem regularum istarum spectat vetustatem, aliis maturiùs sancitas, aliis verò tardiùs conflatas existimantibus. Cave tamen CLARISSIME DALLÆE ne ita meam mentem explices, velut Episcopatui qualis inter Protestantes Anglos obtinet infensius essem, ab sit à me talis animi cogitatio: Episcopatum enim ipsum juris esse divini ingenuè profiteor: Et quamvis Episcoporum eminentiam supra Presbyteros institutionis esse mere humanæ firmissimè credam, præstat tamen meo quidem judicio regimen illud Episcopale patienter ferre, eiquè ultrò ac sponte se subjicere, quàm dissidia aut Schismata illius occasione excitare & fovere in Ecclesiâ, in quâ omnia εὐσχημόνως καὶ κατὰ τάξιν fieri debent:

page.notes: The Greek phrase εὐσχημόνως καὶ κατὰ τάξιν is printed in smaller type, inline in the last line, and is transcribed where it stands. The word "absit" is printed as "absit" with a spacing irregularity at the scan. The text ends mid-page, with no further printed lines below the last line.
